policy: J3·把 J2 的两张新 KF 转动态镜。KF3=石碑全景（单火盆），KF8=她贴玻璃（单人影）。无口型问题、无人物台词。

units.note: 石碑全景动态化：火光呼吸+尘埃，极缓推进不改构图
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A locked-off view of a black basalt stele in a narrow stone chamber at night, an Assyrian winged sun disc carved on its crown. On the left only, one clay fire bowl burns; its flame breathes low and steady, throwing warm light that swells and falls across the blank stone face. Fine ash drifts slowly through the beam and settles. The camera eases forward with a very small amplitude over the whole take. Deep warm black on the right, fine 35mm grain, black point slightly lifted.

units.note: 她贴玻璃动态化：手停留+指尖轻移+玻璃反光微动，只有一个人
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. From behind, a young woman in a cream knit sweater stands at an illuminated museum display case, her right palm pressed flat on the glass. Her hand stays planted while her fingertips shift once, slowly, as if tracing a shape on the surface; her head tilts a fraction toward the case. In the glass, the reflection of her profile and the carved stone inside drift subtly with the smallest camera float. The gallery behind her stays dark and empty. She does not speak. Cool ceiling light above, one warm glow from inside the case, fine 35mm grain.
